picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant renewal for MassAITC is one of the largest funding commitments in this batch, backing a multi-year academic-hospital partnership to apply AI to aging and Alzheimer's care at scale.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: A cross-institution team (MIT, CMU, NYU, Stanford) built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI with techniques that generalize to real-world strategic decision-making.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's Belfer Center 'pre-mortem' report on catastrophic AI risk, citing real incidents like rogue-agent breaches and OpenAI's training pause, is a timely policy intervention in the AI safety debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip offering rapid, low-cost screening for leukemia and liver disease could meaningfully expand diagnostic access in resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's 'InstructMesh,' developed with Google and Northeastern, solves a practical gap in generative 3D modeling by letting users repair AI-generated meshes before fabrication.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool to estimate radiation exposure from routine blood tests offers a faster, more accessible alternative to specialized biodosimetry, with clear public-health emergency-response applications.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's AI models help pathologists spot precancerous colon lesions the human eye tends to miss, a direct improvement to cancer-screening accuracy.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's $8M in federal Strengthening Institutions Program grants will expand AI education and workforce training, broadening access to AI skills development.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory pairs space-based computing with AI-driven weather modeling, an industry-government-academia partnership with dual-use research potential.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: Inria and a French emergency department are building an AI tool that analyzes voice and speech during emergency calls to detect heart attacks, a novel application with potential to speed life-saving triage.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions
